I fixed the pricing page on phones. The three plan cards were staying side by side at phone width, which made the page 486px wide on a 390px screen. I added `.plans` to the single-column rules in the `@media (max-width: 720px)` block in `site/css/pages.css`, so the cards now stack.

I re-ran the visual tests. All 12 snapshots now match the approved baselines, including `pricing__phone`, so I didn't need to approve or change any baselines. I didn't run the functional tests, and I haven't looked at the page on a real phone.

I didn't commit anything.
